Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: "Why Is That Ferret Wearing a Fedora?" An OWCA Guide for Those in the Know.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Billy the Beaver, you are a secret agent?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (as Billy) Alas, you know my mysterious secret. (to the camera) Hello. Now that you know about one of our agents, please follow these OWCA guidelines.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (voiceover) Doonie Do-Good knows it's his responsibility to step in and use any skills he has to help.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (voiceover) But Dougie Do-Nothing hesitates and...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (voiceover) Can you see what went wrong?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Thanks for sharing this, Perry. To be honest, it's been a little awkward since I found out about your secret last summer. But it is weird this specific thing happens so often there's a premade video to deal with it. But even weirder that they shot it on film. I mean, how old is this video? Anyway, rest assured, I'll be a Donnie Do-Good.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (coughs) You know we have a front door. (coughs)

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: Thank you girls for helping out with the Doctor & Scientist Symposium. Two of our servers got food poisoning and had to drop out. Oh, and hopefully this is not the food that caused that. Excuse me.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, thanks, Candace. With both of us here, it should be fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No problem, Stacy. I mean, I am a little disappointed that I'll miss out on busting my brothers today, but at least I get to serve food to a room full of strangers.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It'll be easy. All we have to do is wrangle a few doctors and scientists, "This way to the dessert table." It's like herding very smart cattle. (Moos like a cow.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! I forgot how strangely impressive you are at very specific animal sounds.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yes, I'm very good at a skill I would never need to use in real life. You should hear my hiccuping dolphin. (does a dolphin chatter, hiccups)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, let's get back to it.

Name: Doofenshmirt
Dialog: Hello, doctors and scientists of Danville!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, it's weird that I was not invited to this. I'm a doctor and a scientist. An evil scientist. Not an evil doctor. That would be weird. And now, as they say in Uruguay, point me to the buffet! And... who's kidding how? The buffet's the only reason I came.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Free shrimp. It's a perk. (swallows one, does her dolphin imitation again)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yep, that is a useless skill.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, thanks for coming in this evening. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted interacting with other doctors and scientists and must be up to something evil.

Name: Carl
Dialog: What makes you say that, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Duh, it's his whole shtick. It's on the side of his building. Anyway, Agent P, go do what it is you do.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: "Why do I think he's evil". Have you ever even watched this show?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah, this is where all the years of studying evil science really pays off. (Doof looks behind him to catch a familiar sight.) Ah, Dr. Diminutive. I won't say it's good to see you, but it is, it is hard to see you because you're so small. (laughs)

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: I'm easier to see than your ex-wife, 'cause, y'know, you're so divorced.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We wanted different things. She wanted to not be married to me. So what's new, Short Stuff?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Not that it's any of your business, Heinz, but I've been trying to win the L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. tag and bag contest. Just my luck that Agent Silent G is out of town this week.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, what tag and bag contest?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (reading) "Bring Your Nemesis In for Bragging Rights and a Special Prize!!!" That's easier said than done. I catch Perry the Platypus every day, but like suppressed flatulence, he always manages to escape.

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Charming.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I... I may have overshared there.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (gasps) Perry?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, no! Candace can't see him in agent mode! What else does it say in the video?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Remember the three D's. "Distraction", "Discussion", or "Diversion". Make a "Decision". Nope, four. I guess there are four.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Distraction.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ow!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, did you know that my boyfriend, Coltrane, is secretly on the Venezuelan Olympic luge team? Well, (giggles) he isn't.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, look over there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't see anything over here that wasn't over there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? What's he doing here? He's not a doctor. I don't think he's a doctor. I... I don't know for sure, I guess. He... He is truly an enigma. Wait, Diminutive! Whenever I trap Perry the Platypus, he escapes.

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Yeah, you said that already.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But if you and I teamed up and both trapped Perry the Platypus, he'd be twice as trapped and we could split the tag and bag prize!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Heinz, as reluctant as I am to agree with you, that's actually a good idea!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh! Ooh! We can call ourselves Double Doctor Squad! Oh, no, that abbreviates to D.D.S, and I don't want people to think we're dentists. Ooh, how about Doof 'n' Diminutive Squad? No, no, same thing. Name TBD. Let's go!

Name: Emcee
Dialog: And the award for most ingenious use of nucleotides in an amusement park ride goes to, once again, it's Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did I hear "Phineas and Ferb"?

Name: Scientist 1
Dialog: No, I was wondering aloud, "Is 'hideous' a verb?" Turn out it's an adjective. It means ugly.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, what are you doing here? Besides getting trapped! (laughs) You've been double-trapped by Dr. D. Squared. Yeah, that's still not right.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (gulp) This is not good. Uh, Candace, could you hold down the fort? This shrimp cocktail isn't agreeing with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Go. I got this.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Donnie Do-Good is on the job!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P? Great googly moogly! You're not Agent P! I mean, uh, that is... Look over there!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: My name is Stacy Hirano. I know Perry's a secret agent, and he's been captured. I'm in pursuit now.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: This is highly irregular. I really... Can you turn the screen sideways? I really don't look good in the vertical aspect ratio.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (does so) Sorry, sir, but there's no time to go through proper channels. But I've seen the video. I'm a Donnie Do-Good.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, she's our only hope. All our other agents are being dewormed.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, right. I forgot Agent W is missing. Go, young lady, go!

Name: Emcee
Dialog: And the area for exceptional rocket science in a supporting role goes to Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now I know I heard "Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Scientist 2
Dialog: No, I said, "Fibbing is for the birds". It's part of my presentation I'm making later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) That doesn't even make sense.

Name: Scientist 2
Dialog: I worked hard on this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ouch, they're really cranking up the evil a notch. I... I think they burned off my fingertips.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello, hi? We're here to turn in my nemesis. Where's our prize?

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: (hands Doof a clipboard) Uh-huh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Paperwork. That's the real evil.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Do you have a short form?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: (offended) What's that supposed to mean?!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What do I do? What do I do?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (voiceover) In a crisis, rely on your own unique skill set. For instance, Carl here knows how to yo-yo.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, special skills. Uh, miniature golf, babysitting, gymnastics, third level black belt in taekwondo.

Name: Echo
Dialog: Taekwondo... Taekwondo...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I forgot how strangely impressive you are at very specific animal sounds. Animal sounds. Animal sounds.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I also make all those weird animal noises!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait. What is this? Now we have to fill these forms out in the dark? Is that what...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And I thought this would never come in handy.

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: It's the agents of OWCA!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: And Danny the Dolphin has the hiccups, apparently.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: They've got us surrounded! Every evil scientist for himself!

Name: Female Evil Scientist
Dialog: Their little fedoras give me the willies!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, I guess the gymnastics helps, too. Ha!

Name: Male Evil Scientist
Dialog: Eh?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And the taekwondo! I wonder if the miniature golf will come in handy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, what is this? Perry the Platypus in a death trap? What the—When did L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. get so evil? And wh—Hippos? Wait, aren't sharks more traditional in a death trap?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Yeah, actually, hippos are much more dangerous than sharks.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not interested right now, Shorty. Jeez, read the room.

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: (under his breath) No prize is worth this.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Now what? It's not like I can just march in there among all those evil scientists. Or can I? These weirdos are expecting animal agents to break in, (smiles) not teenage girls.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hello? Did one of you guys call for a babysitter?

Name: Male Evil Scientist 2
Dialog: Who is that girl and what does she want?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (looking at a piece of paper) This is 989 Poomwle, right? (turns paper upside-down) Oh, I'm sorry. 686 Elmwood?

Name: Male Evil Scientist 3
Dialog: Hey, did one of you order a babysitter?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Fore! I used mini golf!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm so sorry, Perry the Platypus. I would never have brought you here if I'd known about the whole death by hippos deal. That is... That is not my style. That is...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, I get it. Go ahead. Thwart me. I deserve it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Excellent work. Looks like Donnie Do-Good did good.

Name: Emcee
Dialog: And our final award of the night... Aw, who'm I kidding? It's Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I swear someone just said, "Phine—" AAAAH! Stacy, where have you been?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ugh, the shrimp cocktail.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, that's the worst. I'm so sorry. Sriracha cheese stick?

Name: Candace
Dialog: For teen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (opens a door) Got any more in here?
